evidence: Swap test fails: replace the tool names with library books, community-hall rooms or bike-hire stock and the find page (wordmark in body-weight sans + stock wrench glyph, H1, search bar + filter button, 2-column grid of white bordered cards each with an identical square icon tile, a title link, a meta line and a pale-green badge) survives unchanged; only copy is bound to the product.

Category-guess test fails: predicted default for a community booking/reservation flow = pale ground, one green 'community' accent, one geometric/humanist sans, bordered cards, filled primary button, GOV.UK-style form and error summary. Every identity-carrying element matches it (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light, basket/errors/375-light error summary, confirm/default/1280-light form).

Similar-prompt test fails: a brief for a seed library or toy library reservation would land on the same frame: same card grid with a placeholder icon tile, same calendar of day buttons, same session radio cards, same confirm summary box.

Product-bound elements exist but are content, not design: volunteer-voiced tool names ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries'), deposit on every card, 'Open' tag on session days in the pick-up calendar (tool/day-chosen/1280-light), session radio cards with real hours. No signature element; the one product mechanism (sessions) is shown with stock calendar and radio patterns.

evidence: First viewport at 1280 (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light): H1 'Find a tool', paragraph, a search bar, then a uniform grid of placeholder-icon cards; nothing to look at beyond the list.
After a scroll: 'Opening times' is a heading and one paragraph; footer is one line of grey text.
Done page (done/default/1280-light) is two bordered boxes and an outline button on a grey field: the moment a reservation is made carries no visual acknowledgement.
Execution is orderly and the green is pleasant and consistent, so it is not unappealing; it is clean but bare.
